tasks.short: Report a compliance violation to the authorised enforcement agency

loop.output: report form draft and attachment list
loop.check: Required fields and cited evidence are checked against the source record before approval.
loop.stop: Stop after one draft; flag missing evidence for manual completion.
loop.why_not_simpler: The evidence file can contain free text that must be summarised into the report.

tasks.design: A case record in the {WORKFLOW} links the allegation, evidence and reporting deadline held in the {DOCS}. It prepares a report pack and submits it through the {GOV_PORTAL} only after the compliance manager approves the exact report version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence, reporting rules and portal forms were handled in separate documents and screens.
tasks.enabler_now: A structured case record can retain evidence links, deadlines and the approved submission version.
tasks.still_hard: The duty to report, the completeness of the evidence and the external legal consequence require professional judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The compliance manager decides whether facts meet the reporting threshold and takes responsibility for the filing.

ambition.what: review near-miss allegations before a reporting deadline is missed

tasks.altitude: The manager spends less time copying evidence into forms and more time setting reporting criteria and resolving difficult cases.

reach.learn: how obligations map to report fields and deadlines

evidence.claim: A records workflow can hold versioned policy and compliance material with multi-stage approvals.
A compliance platform can support compliance, incident and regulatory-monitoring work.
External reporting requirements and retention duties depend on the applicable regulator.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: alleged violation through authorised external submission and receipt.

Input contract: allegation id, event date, rule reference, evidence links, owner, regulator and deadline are supplied by the case owner; missing fields are manually entered and missing document text is extracted for review.
Native {WORKFLOW} case, deadline and approval configuration is tested before custom integration.
The incremental allowance covers maintaining field mappings and portal changes.
unknowns: Which violation types require reporting, which portal interfaces exist, and whether a second signatory is required.
research_questions: Can the regulator accept structured submissions or uploaded packages from the existing portal?
Which evidence fields are mandatory for each report type?

already_counted.description: Review triage evidence and the exact submission version.

incremental.description: Maintain report-field mappings and portal exceptions.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conservative scenarios retain full reporting-duty judgement and submission review, and deduct 3 focal-role upkeep hours per 100 baseline hours; provisional, not measured.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Identify compliance issues requiring follow-up or investigation

steps.what: Collect audit findings and incident signals

loop.output: proposed issue type, rule reference and missing facts
loop.check: The compliance manager compares the proposed type and rule reference with the supplied report.
loop.stop: Classify once; route low-confidence or incomplete reports to manual triage.
loop.why_not_simpler: Incident narratives use free text and cannot be mapped safely by fixed fields alone.

steps.what: Open follow-up case and assign owner

tasks.design: The {WORKFLOW} collects audit findings, incidents and policy exceptions into one issue intake. It proposes a classification from the linked {DOCS}, opens follow-up work after the manager’s materiality decision, and shows unresolved cases in a queue.
tasks.previous_blocker: Signals arrived in different mailboxes and documents, making it hard to see related or overdue issues.
tasks.enabler_now: A single intake record, rule-based routing and a bounded text classification can be connected without automating the materiality decision.
tasks.still_hard: Context, potential harm and the appropriate scope of an investigation cannot be set reliably from a classification alone.
tasks.human_edge: The manager recognises when a pattern needs escalation despite incomplete or conflicting evidence.

ambition.what: review a complete cross-source issue queue each week

tasks.altitude: The manager manages investigation priorities and recurrent-control failures instead of compiling intake lists.

evidence.claim: A compliance platform can provide incident and regulatory-monitoring modules.
A protocol and incident system can forward reports to the responsible person.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: issue signal through assigned follow-up case.

Input contract: source id, event date, reporter, location, policy reference, narrative and evidence link are supplied by the originating audit or incident process; missing values are entered manually and narrative text is extracted for review.
Native {WORKFLOW} intake, assignment and queue features are tested before custom code.
The incremental allowance covers category and routing-rule upkeep.
unknowns: Which signal sources can be connected, how many reports lack evidence, and who owns each investigation type.
research_questions: Do existing issue categories match the policy taxonomy?
What threshold currently causes an investigation to be opened?

already_counted.description: Review unresolved cases in the queue.

incremental.description: Maintain issue categories and assignment rules.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conservative scenarios retain all materiality decisions and most queue review, and deduct 4 focal-role upkeep hours per 100 baseline hours; provisional, not measured.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Discuss emerging compliance issues with managers and employees

steps.what: Gather new rules and internal signals

loop.output: proposed policy impact note with source passages
loop.check: The compliance manager checks every proposed impact against the supplied update and policy text.
loop.stop: Stop after one comparison; identify ambiguous passages for manual analysis.
loop.why_not_simpler: The relevant changes and policy wording are unstructured documents.

loop.input: briefing plan and approved impact note
loop.output: briefing outline, examples and question log
loop.check: The manager checks accuracy, tone and the action request before use.
loop.stop: Produce one outline; omit claims without a source passage.
loop.why_not_simpler: A useful briefing needs prose tailored to the audience and supplied policy text.

steps.what: Discuss the change and answer questions

tasks.design: The {WORKFLOW} keeps a change record linked to source text and policy versions in the {DOCS}. It prepares an impact note and briefing pack, while the compliance manager chooses the audience, leads the discussion and records commitments.
tasks.previous_blocker: Change notices, policies and staff questions were assembled manually for each briefing.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned policy records and a bounded document comparison can prepare source-linked material for a human-led discussion.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining the practical effect, responding to concern and agreeing local action need dialogue and judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The manager adapts the message to the audience and resolves questions where rules conflict with operational reality.

ambition.what: give frontline supervisors a short, source-linked compliance briefing

tasks.altitude: The manager designs a regular change-communication rhythm and uses discussions to find unclear controls.

evidence.claim: Versioned policy management can map policies to rules and support multi-stage approvals.
A documented failure showed that unverified model output can include fabricated sources.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: new compliance change through briefing and recorded commitments.

Input contract: source document, effective date, policy version, affected audience, owner and action due date are supplied by the policy owner; missing metadata is entered manually and source text is extracted for review.
Native {DOCS} versioning and {WORKFLOW} notification features are tested before custom code.
The incremental allowance covers briefing templates and audience lists.
unknowns: Which groups require a briefing, which policy changes are material, and how questions are currently retained.
research_questions: Can employees acknowledge a briefing in the existing workflow?
Which questions recur after policy changes?

already_counted.description: Lead the discussion and answer questions.

incremental.description: Maintain briefing templates and audience lists.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conservative scenarios retain all live discussion and message decisions, and deduct 4 focal-role upkeep hours per 100 baseline hours; provisional, not measured.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: File the appropriate compliance report with a regulatory agency

steps.what: Confirm compliance report type and filing period
Reconcile compliance report records and fields
Populate compliance report form and attachments
Validate figures and certify compliance report
Transmit certified compliance report and store receipt

tasks.design: A configured filing schedule in the {WORKFLOW} identifies the due report, reconciles approved source records from the {DATA_PLATFORM}, and prepares the form for the {GOV_PORTAL}. The compliance manager certifies the exact version before transmission and the receipt returns to the filing record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Data reconciliation, form preparation and receipt storage were separate manual activities.
tasks.enabler_now: Structured field mappings and validation rules can prepare repeatable filings without replacing certification.
tasks.still_hard: Completeness, interpretation of reporting rules and certification remain accountable human work.
tasks.human_edge: The compliance manager judges whether reconciled facts answer the regulator’s question and can certify them.

ambition.what: review filing exceptions before the scheduled deadline

tasks.altitude: The manager monitors exceptions and reporting controls instead of rekeying standard filing data.

reach.learn: field-level filing controls and receipt retention

evidence.claim: A compliance platform can support regulatory-monitoring modules.
Regulatory reports need organisation-specific field mappings and certification controls.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: reporting calendar through submitted filing receipt.

Input contract: filing type, reporting period, entity id, required fields, source-record ids, certifier and portal credentials are supplied by the reporting owner; missing data is manually corrected and document values are extracted for review.
Native {GOV_PORTAL} export and {WORKFLOW} filing features are tested before custom integration.
The incremental allowance covers changed forms, mappings and validation rules.
unknowns: Which reports permit machine-prepared data, which systems hold the source records, and whether the portal provides an interface.
research_questions: What reconciliations must be evidenced before certification?
Can the existing portal return a receipt identifier to the workflow?

already_counted.description: Review reconciled fields and certify the filing.

incremental.description: Maintain filing mappings and validation rules.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conservative scenarios retain reconciliation review and full certification, and deduct 5 focal-role upkeep hours per 100 baseline hours; provisional, not measured.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Set reporting controls, investigation priorities and change-communication criteria rather than compiling records.
reach: Regulatory affairs manager: manage obligation and filing calendars.
role.ambitious_version: Run a traceable compliance control room that surfaces issues and overdue obligations before they become filings.
